Stun.description: Prevents all actions and movement for $Durations.

passives.name: CellPassive1
passives.description:
After this unit scores 50 takedowns in CellTransformation1:
- Spawn Mecha17 as an enemy Boss
- Mecha17 health is 10000
When Mecha17 is defeated:
- This unit transforms from CellTransformation1 to CellTransformation2
After this unit scores 50 takedowns in CellTransformation2:
- Spawn Mecha18 as an enemy Boss
- Mecha18 health is 20000
When Mecha18 is defeated:
- This unit transforms from CellTransformation2 to CellTransformation3

passives.name: CellPassive2
passives.description:
In Imperfect form:
- Copy 50% base damage of the strongest unit in range
In Semiperfect form:
- This unit gains BioGel on attack
- Unlock CellAbility1
BioGel will:
- Slow enemies by 60% for 5 seconds
- Stun enemies for 3 seconds on expiry
In Perfect form:
Unlock CellAbility2
On Takedown of an enemy inflicted with BioGel:
- Increase this unit's range by 0.2% (Capacity: 30%)
- Increase this unit's AoE size by 0.4% (Capacity: 20%)
